key: Hello there!
en: Hello there!
ja: こんにちは!

key: I'm researching the geological history of the Reborn Region!
en: I'm researching the geological history of the Reborn Region!
ja: リボーン地方の地質の歴史を研究しているの!

key: Interested?
en: Interested?
ja: 興味ある?

key: Wonderful! Let's start with this. Did you know that long ago, Ametrine Mountain used to be a volcano?
en: Wonderful! Let's start with this. Did you know that long ago, Ametrine Mountain used to be a volcano?
ja: よかった! まずはこれから。昔、アメトリン山が火山だったって知ってた?

key: But that's not all! Pyrous Mountain in Apophyll used to be as frigid as Ametrine now is!
en: But that's not all! Pyrous Mountain in Apophyll used to be as frigid as Ametrine now is!
ja: それだけじゃないの! アポフィルのパイロス山は、昔は今のアメトリン山みたいに凍りついていたのよ!

key: Legends from an old civilization say that the day their civilization ended was the day that Giratina came to Reborn.
en: Legends from an old civilization say that the day their civilization ended was the day that Giratina came to Reborn.
ja: 古い文明の伝説によれば、その文明が滅びた日こそ、ギラティナがリボーンに現れた日なんですって。

key: They say the dragon was in a frenzy, and all around it bizarre things would happen.
en: They say the dragon was in a frenzy, and all around it bizarre things would happen.
ja: そのドラゴンは狂乱していて、周囲では奇怪な出来事が次々に起きたそうよ。

key: Objects would disappear, lands would be spun upside down, and whole towns were transported across the region in the blink of an eye.
en: Objects would disappear, lands would be spun upside down, and whole towns were transported across the region in the blink of an eye.
ja: 物が消えたり、大地がひっくり返ったり、町ごと一瞬で地方の別の場所へ移動したり。

key: According to the stories, by the time the dimensional warrior finally settled in the south-east of the region, its chaos had already sealed the fate of Reborn.
en: According to the stories, by the time the dimensional warrior finally settled in the south-east of the region, its chaos had already sealed the fate of Reborn.
ja: 伝承によれば、その次元の戦士が地方の南東にようやく落ち着いたころには、その混乱がすでにリボーンの運命を決定づけていたの。

key: Ametrine froze, and every speck of magma turned into crystal clear ice water.
en: Ametrine froze, and every speck of magma turned into crystal clear ice water.
ja: アメトリンは凍りつき、マグマの一粒一粒が透き通った氷の水に変わった。

key: Pyrous erupted all at once, a volley of smoke and snow upheaved from its peak.
en: Pyrous erupted all at once, a volley of smoke and snow upheaved from its peak.
ja: パイロスは一気に噴火し、頂上から煙と雪が吹き上がったの。

key: The lava bled down the slope, burning away what traces of lives had been there in what is now Apophyll.
en: The lava bled down the slope, burning away what traces of lives had been there in what is now Apophyll.
ja: 溶岩が斜面を流れ落ち、今のアポフィルにあった生活の痕跡を焼き尽くしたわ。

key: And in the months to follow, the rising temperatures thawed the snow, which formed what is now Azurine Lake,
en: And in the months to follow, the rising temperatures thawed the snow, which formed what is now Azurine Lake,
ja: その後の数か月で気温が上がり、雪が解けて、今のアズリン湖ができたの。

key: Burying their old city beneath it.
en: Burying their old city beneath it.
ja: 古い都市はその下に埋もれてしまった。

key: I hear some divers can still find artifacts from those days down there!
en: I hear some divers can still find artifacts from those days down there!
ja: 今でも潜水士があの頃の遺物を見つけることがあるらしいわよ!

key: As for Giratina...
en: As for Giratina...
ja: ギラティナのことだけど……

key: I wonder what could have happened to it? The records about it ended there.
en: I wonder what could have happened to it? The records about it ended there.
ja: あれからどうなったのかしら? 記録はそこで途切れているの。

key: Ohmigod, it's YOU!
en: Ohmigod, it's YOU!
ja: うそ、あなただったのね!

key: I've seen you on TV-- you know, Gossip Gardevoir's show? Introduce me sometime!
en: I've seen you on TV-- you know, Gossip Gardevoir's show? Introduce me sometime!
ja: テレビで見たわ――ほら、ゴシップサーナイトの番組! いつか紹介してよ!

key: But she's showed us all about how you've been fighting Team Meteor and saving Reborn!
en: But she's showed us all about how you've been fighting Team Meteor and saving Reborn!
ja: あなたがチームメテオと戦って、リボーンを救ってきたこと、彼女がみんなに見せてくれたの!

key: That's SO cool!
en: That's SO cool!
ja: すごくかっこいいわ!

key: Oh my god, can I do something to help you?
en: Oh my god, can I do something to help you?
ja: ねえ、何かあなたの力になれることないかしら?

key: Anything? Wait! I know!
en: Anything? Wait! I know!
ja: 何でもいいの? あ! そうだ!

key: I have a Sticker! It's not much!
en: I have a Sticker! It's not much!
ja: シールを持ってるの! たいしたものじゃないけど!

key: In fact I feel like a little kid saying that... But surely it can be of some small use, right?
en: In fact I feel like a little kid saying that... But surely it can be of some small use, right?
ja: こんなこと言うと子どもみたいだけど……でも、少しは役に立つはずよね?

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker!
ja: \PNはデパートシールを手に入れた!

key: Think of me whenever you use it!
en: Think of me whenever you use it!
ja: 使うときはわたしのこと思い出してね!

key: Oh, and you should take this, too!
en: Oh, and you should take this, too!
ja: あ、これも持っていって!

key: Wait, what do you mean you don't have a Department Store Card!?
en: Wait, what do you mean you don't have a Department Store Card!?
ja: ちょっと、デパートカードを持ってないってどういうこと!?

key: You've been kicking ass in Reborn for HOW long and you haven't gotten one yet?
en: You've been kicking ass in Reborn for HOW long and you haven't gotten one yet?
ja: リボーンでずっと大活躍してきたのに、まだ持ってないなんて?

key: You just gotta fix that!
en: You just gotta fix that!
ja: それは今すぐ直さなきゃ!

key: And then! Aaah!
en: And then! Aaah!
ja: それで! ああっ!

key: I can be your first...
en: I can be your first...
ja: わたしがあなたの最初の……

key: ...Uh, first Sticker-giver! That's what I meant!
en: ...Uh, first Sticker-giver! That's what I meant!
ja: ……えっと、最初にシールをあげた人ってことよ! そういう意味!

key: Don't read too far into it!
en: Don't read too far into it!
ja: 変な意味に取らないでよね!

key: Think of me whenever you go to that store!
en: Think of me whenever you go to that store!
ja: あのお店に行くときは、わたしのこと思い出してね!

key: I moved out to Apophyll when things started getting rough, and I was excited to come back now that they're better.
en: I moved out to Apophyll when things started getting rough, and I was excited to come back now that they're better.
ja: 大変な時期になってアポフィルに引っ越したの。落ち着いてきたから、戻ってこられてうれしかったわ。

key: But somehow, I miss it out there?
en: But somehow, I miss it out there?
ja: でも、なんだかあっちが恋しくなっちゃって?

key: Maybe I'll go back-- of my own free will this time.
en: Maybe I'll go back-- of my own free will this time.
ja: また戻ろうかしら――今度は自分の意志でね。

key: Kiki would be proud if I decided to do that, right?
en: Kiki would be proud if I decided to do that, right?
ja: そうしたら、キキも喜んでくれるわよね?

key: I wish I could get the ring back, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
en: I wish I could get the ring back, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
ja: 指輪を取り戻せたらいいんだけど、あれはオーダーメイドだから、同じものをただ買うわけにはいかないの。

key: and of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
en: and of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
ja: それに、湖の中から見つけ出せるわけもないし。

key: Ugggh, what am I going to do?
en: Ugggh, what am I going to do?
ja: ああ、わたしどうすればいいの?

key: My relationship is over.
en: My relationship is over.
ja: わたしたちの関係はもう終わりよ。

key: No,
en: No,
ja: ううん、

key: My life is over.
en: My life is over.
ja: わたしの人生が終わりよ。

key: I'm going to die of embarrassment.
en: I'm going to die of embarrassment.
ja: 恥ずかしさで死んでしまいそう。

key: Sorry, I'll start from the beginning.
en: Sorry, I'll start from the beginning.
ja: ごめんなさい、最初から話すわね。

key: My fiancee and I had a little... misunderstanding?
en: My fiancee and I had a little... misunderstanding?
ja: 婚約者とちょっとした……誤解があったの。

key: I thought they were cheating on me, so when I got mad, I flung my engagement ring out into the lake.
en: I thought they were cheating on me, so when I got mad, I flung my engagement ring out into the lake.
ja: 浮気されてると思い込んで、腹が立って、婚約指輪を湖に投げ捨ててしまったの。

key: The truth was cleared up later, and everything's okay with us now,
en: The truth was cleared up later, and everything's okay with us now,
ja: 誤解は後で解けて、今は仲直りしてるんだけど、

key: But I haven't told them that I lost the ring yet.
en: But I haven't told them that I lost the ring yet.
ja: 指輪をなくしたことは、まだ言えていないの。

key: I've never felt regret like this...
en: I've never felt regret like this...
ja: こんな後悔、初めてよ……

key: I wish I could fix it, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
en: I wish I could fix it, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
ja: なんとかしたいけど、あの指輪はオーダーメイドだから、同じものをただ買うわけにはいかないし、

key: And of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
en: And of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
ja: 湖の中から見つけ出せるわけもないわ。

key: Hey, wait...
en: Hey, wait...
ja: ちょっと、待って……

key: That ring you've got there... There's no way...
en: That ring you've got there... There's no way...
ja: そのあなたが持ってる指輪……まさか……

key: Did you really find it!?
en: Did you really find it!?
ja: 本当に見つけてくれたの!?

key: That's incredible!
en: That's incredible!
ja: すごいわ!

key: You are a true savior!
en: You are a true savior!
ja: あなたは本物の救世主ね!

key: To be honest, I chanced across something interesting, and I was considering doing something drastic in order to pay for a custom replacement.
en: To be honest, I chanced across something interesting, and I was considering doing something drastic in order to pay for a custom replacement.
ja: 正直に言うと、面白いものを偶然手に入れて、それを売って新しいオーダーメイドの指輪代にしようかとも考えていたの。

key: But since you found it, why don't you take this instead?
en: But since you found it, why don't you take this instead?
ja: でも見つけてくれたんだから、代わりにこれをもらってくれない?

key: I don't really know what that's about either, but at least I won't have to be responsible for it now.
en: I don't really know what that's about either, but at least I won't have to be responsible for it now.
ja: これが何なのかよくわからないけど、少なくとも、もう責任を負わなくて済むわ。

key: Hopefully you can find a use for it!
en: Hopefully you can find a use for it!
ja: あなたなら使い道を見つけられるといいけど!

key: Thank you for finding my ring!
en: Thank you for finding my ring!
ja: 指輪を見つけてくれてありがとう!

key: Oh, and as for that other thing, could you not mention that to anyone?
en: Oh, and as for that other thing, could you not mention that to anyone?
ja: あ、それともう一つのことは、誰にも言わないでもらえる?

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 15!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 15!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書15を手に入れた!

key: Info on Forest Field now available!
en: Info on Forest Field now available!
ja: フォレストフィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
